name: task-manifest-ready-gate
title: Invoke the seeded-task gate before starting a Trellis task
description: workflow.md:424 requires a real entry in implement.jsonl and check.jsonl before task.py start. The enforcing check already exists in the installed pack -- scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review-preflight.mjs:617, the seeded-task command, verified refusing a seed-only task and passing a curated one -- but nothing in this repository invokes it. Wire it into the start path.
creator: sdelmas
